run_gen_summary: run the summary generation pipeline for all images up to IDX_TARGET using Llama-2-70b
gen_summaries_for: generate base and mask summaries for a single DenseCaptionedImage index using a remote language model

refactor_run_gen_summary: refactor the run_gen_summary function to change the target model or adjust thread count
